reviews.comment: John is very helpful to my study and offer the practice problems before exam which is improve my study speed and quality
Professor Treuer explained very clearly the ideas behind the formulas and how to use them.   Homeworks and exams were just like the lectures

Dr. Treuer is really great and has incredible dry humor. By engaging in lecture, I really enjoyed MATH 304. Very reasonable test difficulty, and very reasonable homework amounts. I would highly recommend Dr. Treuer!

Treuer is, admittedly, a little monotone at times. However, this just makes it all the more funny when he makes a dry joke. As far as teaching goes, he explains things clearly during lecture and the resources he provides for exam prep are extremely valuable.

I really thought I'd struggle in this class but Prof Treuer was very accessible for office hours and that was really helpful for me to succeed.  He is a very nice person and good resource for students
Decent professor that explains concepts fairly well. Just very monotone and unengaging. Exams are pretty similar to practice exams and homework. Ended up rounding up grades at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's an okay lecturer and nice guy, but it was really hard for me to pay attention, so I just stopped going to class. He's just very monotone. His notes are good, so I just studied those along with the homework. Exams are very similar to the homework.

His lectures may put you to sleep, especially if you have him for an 8 am, but the lectures are just like the homework, and he frequently pulls exam questions directly from the homework. It's a very straightforward class and can be a solid GPA boost.
he's definitely a homie but paying attention is difficult because he's very monotone/not engaging. he records his lectures and posts lecture notes and he's rlly nice :)
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Monotone professor, but that's just his delivery, he's chill. He'll answer questions and walk through lectures pretty well. Weekly textbook HW that can be done ~2hrs or less. No quizzes, so 2 exams and the final make up ~80% of the grade. Exams are very similar to assigned HW problems, so no need to study more outside of that and notes to get an A.

He is a fantastic professor, his teaching style is very helpful to learn. His tests are the hardest tests I have ever taken. He's very personable and makes cheesy jokes and is pretty responsive in class, but my holy heavens I recommend a tutor to help with the tests because I simply could not
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I would give him a 0, but since I can't, he gets a 1. One of the worst professors I have ever had. Exams are ridiculously hard and the lectures don't help. Boring lectures. Do not take.

While his lectures are not that exciting, he covered the material that was on the exams. The homework is very similar to the exams and if you redo homework and quiz problems you will be ready for the exams. The quizzes are take home so you should get all the points. He is happy to answer questions. Go to office hours. Do the homework!! STUDY

Dr. Treuer while extremely boring in lecture and will put you to sleep in the morning, is pretty smart and straight to the point if you have questions. Highly recommend just grinding the homework and learning from them if you want to do well on his hard exams.

If you have him as your professor, it wont be the end of the world. His lectures are OK but I found it more helpful referencing notes from other professors. The exams he gives you are straightforward questions from similar difficulty as the homework, lecture, and quizzes. Study and you will pass.

He is very monotone and not a good teacher. He doesn't give any practice exams, and each midterm only had 5 questions, so you have no idea which topics will be on the exam. Calc 3 should not be super difficult if you have a good professor, but he made it harder than it needed to be. Would not recommend.

He's extremely monotone and will make you fall asleep during class. Calc 3 is not supposed to be as hard as he makes it. It's his first year teaching so there are no past exams to practice before tests. Even though he gives take-home quizzes and homework, he gives the hardest exams out of all 251 professors and it makes it hard to pass the class.

The lectures are abysmally boring and have no structure. You don't know what the topic will be until he starts doing an example. Even then, it's impossible to be engaged because of his monotone voice. The worst thing is when we had a 50min exam in a 75min class, so Treuer would start the lecture for the next unit in those 25min. Stay away

Easily my best professor at A&M. Made Calculus 3 my easiest STEM course. He reminded us about important deadlines and schedule changes. He gave take-home, open-note (and buddy) quizzes. The homework and practice problems prepared me well for the exam. Lectures were solid and also recorded. The usual amount of math homework given. Highly recommend.

His exams are straightforward, and he doesn't try to trick you. He does not rush through lecture, and he makes sure to give plenty of examples that are similar to the test questions. He is VERY monotone so make sure you drink coffee before class! However his dry sense of humor is hilarious!
